title: $29 Part 107 Course vs Flight School Ground School: Which Fits You?
sub_heading: Self-paced online prep vs in-person ground school—typical tradeoffs, what's included, and who each model serves.
body_html:
Draft — review before import. Price ranges are illustrative—verify locally.

In short: In-person ground schools offer scheduled classroom time and an instructor in the room; self-paced online courses trade that for flexibility and lower cost. Both prepare for the same FAA knowledge test—you still pay the testing center fee separately.
